<entry id="O01526">
<head-word>סָרַג</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h. </language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="U01923">שָׂרַג</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> ; 
<italic>Saf.</italic></definition>
<notes> of אָרַג), 
<italic>Pi.</italic> סֵירֵג [
<italic>to interlace, plait</italic>,] </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> to strap (in zig-zag); 
<italic>to girth.</italic></definition>
<notes> Kel. XVI, 1 משיְסָרֵג בה וכ' from the time he made three meshes of girthing. Tosef. ib. B. Bath. I, 12 סֵירְגֹו במשיחית וכ' if he strapped it (the disjointed frame) with cords &c. Ib. B. Mets. IX, 4 [read:] שהוא מְסָרֵג בו את המטה with which one girths the bedstead. M. Kat. I, 8 ומסָרְגִין את המטות you may girth the bedsteads (during the festive week). Y. Ber. III, beg. 5
<sup>d</sup>, a. e. כל שמסרגין על וכ' a bedstead on which the girths are drawn on top is called 
<italic>mi</italic>
<italic>ṭṭ</italic>
<italic>ah</italic>, when drawn beneath, 
<italic>dargesh</italic>; Ned. 56
<sup>b</sup> (v. אַבְקָתָא); a. fr.—Trnsf. a) 
<italic>to unite, combine</italic>. Gen. R. s. 85 (ref. to the chronological disorder in the Book of Daniel, in going from Belshazzar (ch. V) to Darius (ch. VI), again to the first year of B. (ch. VII), and to the third year of B. (ch. VIII)) unite כדי לסָרֵג על וכ' in order to combine the entire section as one written in the spirit of holiness; Yalk. ib. 144; Yalk. Dan. 1063 לִסְרֹוג (perh. to be read לסָרֵיג).—b) 
<italic>to make a partition by means of net-work</italic>, like lattices &c. Tosef. Men. X, 23 ומסרגין שם כנגד וכ' and there they fence in an area of about three S’ah.—Part. pass. מְסֹורָג. Ber. 57
<sup>b</sup>, v. next w.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to do a thing in a manner in which straps are drawn in bedsteads</italic> &c., i.e. 
<italic>in zig-zag; to skip</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Nidd. IX, 3 סֵירְגָה לה וכ' if she skipped four days (beyond the ordinary period of menstruation); Nidd. 64
<sup>a</sup> סירגה ליום וכ' if she skipped (from the twenty-first) to the twenty-fourth day. Y. Gitt. VII, 48
<sup>c</sup> bot. ובלבד במְסָרְגִין לו provided they put cross-questions to him alternately (one question to which a positive, and one to which a negative answer are expected, so as to test his sanity).—Part. pass. מְסֹורָג; f. מְסֹורֶגֶת; 
<plural-form>pl. מְסֹורָגִים, מְסֹורָגִין; מְסֹורָגֹות</plural-form>. Mekh. Yithro, Baḥod. s. 6 [read as:] Yalk. Ex. 292 (ref. to Ex.XX, 5) בזמן שהן אינן מסורגין או בזמן שהן מס' (not מסרגין) are the sins of the fathers visited upon the children when the succession is uninterrupted, or even when interrupted (by a good generation)? Y. Snh. I, 19
<sup>c</sup> bot. מס' עלו the differently marked ballots came up alternately. Tosef. Nidd. IX, 13, v. סֵירוּג.—Trnsf. a) 
<italic>to write in broken lines</italic> (leaving a vacant space in the middle of the line); 
<italic>to spread</italic>. Treat. Sof’rim I, 11 מְסָרְגֹו וכ' he spreads the writing so as to make a small column of it.—Part. pass. as ab. Ib. 10 רצוף שעשאו מס' או מס' וכ' if he wrote in broken lines what is to be written in continuous lines or vice versa; או שעשה המס' שלא כהלכתו or if he did the spreading not in accordance with the rule.—b) 
<italic>to trace cross-lines on stone, to carve designs</italic>. Pesik. ‘Ăniya, p. 137
<sup>a</sup> מְסָרְגִין בו carving it; Yalk. Is. 339 (omitted in Pesik. R. s. 32); v. סָתַת.—V. סִירוּג.</notes></sense></senses>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced.; cmp. סָרַח I) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to clutch, hold fast, hang to</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. 86
<sup>b</sup> שאני בהמה דסַרְכָא (Ms. R. דמְסָרְכָא 
<italic>Pa.</italic>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>2)</number>
<definition> it is different with taking possession of an animal, because it clutches (the ground). Ḥull.</definition>
<notes> 51
<sup>a</sup> אית לה מידי למִיסְרַךְ the animal has something to clutch (when falling, so as to break the shock); והאי לית … למ' while this (kid) had nothing to cling to. Ib. top ליכא מידי למיסרך there is no object for the blood to hang to (around which to coagulate); כיון דאיכא מחט … מיסרך הוה סָרֵיךְ since a needle has been found there, if the perforation had taken place before slaughtering, blood would have clung round it; a. e.—Part. pass. סָרִיךְ; f. סְרִיכָא; 
<plural-form>pl. סְרִיכִין; סְרִיכָן</plural-form>. Gitt. 68
<sup>b</sup> שוטה בחדא מילתא לא ס' an insane person does not cling to one fiction (he will betray his insanity in some other way than merely by repeating the same thing). Ḥull. 46
<sup>b</sup> הני … דס' להדדי two lobes of the lungs which adhere to each other (by a membrane). Ned. 50
<sup>b</sup> ואם אית כיבא ס' עלה if there be a sore 
<pgbrk id="pg1028" />in the bowels, it will cling to it (v. טְרוֹמִיטָא); a. e.—2) 
<italic>to confound</italic>, v. infra.</notes></sense></senses>

<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>

<sense>

<sup>a</sup> סריך סליק וכ' it climbed, came up and ate &c. Ib. לסרוכי ולמסלק (not לסרוכיה; Ms. F. למיסרך, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 30) to climb up; a. e.</notes></sense>

<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="O01634">preced.</xref>) 
<italic>to confound</italic>.</definition>

<entry id="O01646">

<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>Pi.</italic> סֵירס (cmp. הָרַס, רָסַס) 
<italic>to destroy, uproot; to mutilate</italic>, esp. 
<italic>to make impotent</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. B. Bath. IV, 7 חלות דבש אינו רשאי לסָרֵס וכ' ed. Zuck. (oth. ed. לירש) if the honey-combs of a bee-hive are sold, the purchaser must not uproot (tear out) all of them at the same time, but must leave the outermost cakes &c. Sot. 36
<sup>a</sup> סֵירְסַתָּן מלמטה it (the wasp צִרְעָה) mutilated them at their lower extremities. Cant. R. to I, 1 סֵירְסוֹ made him impotent. Kidd. 25
<sup>a</sup> עבד שסִרְסוֹ וכ' a slave whom his master mutilated by injury to his testicles. Sabb. 110
<sup>b</sup> הרוצה שיְסָרֵס וכ' if one desires to emasculate a cock, let him take off his comb, and he will thereby be emasculated (without an operation). Ib. 111
<sup>a</sup> במְסָרֵס אחר מסרס if one adds to the mutilation caused by another person; a. fr.—B. Bath. V, 3 נוטל ג' נחלין ומסרס the buyer takes three broods, after which the owner may make the bees impotent of propagation; ib. 80
<sup>a</sup> במה מְסָרְסָן וכ' by what means does one make them impotent?… By feeding them with mustard. Ib. לא חרדל מסרסן וכ' mustard does not make them impotent &c.—Trnsf. 
<italic>to disarrange, upset; to transpose</italic>. Ib. (another interpret. of ומסרס, Mish. l. c.) נוטל … בסירוס, v. סֵירוּס. Ib. 119
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Num. XXVII, 2) סָרֵס המקרא ודרשהו invert the order in which the persons are mentioned in that verse, and interpret it. Lev. R. s. 27, beg. (ref. to Ps. XXXVI, 7) סרס המקרא וכ' transpose the verse, and explain it: ‘thy kindness is as far above thy judgments, as the mountains are above the great deep’. Ex. R. s. 5 (ref. to מי, Ex. V, 2) סרס אותו מי ים וכ' transpose 
<italic>mi</italic> and read 
<italic>yam</italic>, the sea made thee know the Lord; a. fr.—[Lev. R. s. 12 מסרסתו, read: מְסַטַּרְתּוֹ, v. סָטַר.]—
<italic>Part. pass.</italic> מְסוֹרָס 
<italic>upside down, transposed</italic> &c. Nidd. III, 5 יצא … מס' if the embryo came out with its feet foremost. Num. R. s. 11 (ref. to Ex. XX, 24) זה מקרא מס' וכ' this verse must be interpreted by transposition, wherever I shall come and bless thee, there I shall allow my Name (the Tetragrammaton) to be pronounced. Mekh. B’shall., Vayass‘a, s. 4. Gen. R. s. 70 (ref. to Gen. XXVIII, 22) מְסוֹרֶסֶת היא הפרשה the accounts of the section are not in chronological order, opp. על הסדר וכ'; a. e.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִסְתָּרֵס, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>

<sup>b</sup> והוא מִסְתָּרֵס וכ', v. supra. Gen. R. s. 86; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (cmp. עָקַר) 
<italic>to be uprooted, removed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 93
<sup>b</sup> נִסְתָּרְסָה ע"ז וכ' idolatry was uprooted in their days (in the days of Hanania, Mishael &c.). Mekh. Mishp. s. 20 [read:] שלא תִסְתָּרֵס שבת בראשית ממקומה to intimate that the weekly Sabbath is not to be removed from its place, i.e. that it must be observed also in the Sabbatical year; Yalk. Ex. 354. Mekh. l. c. שלא יִסְתָּרְסוּ שלש וכ' that the three festivals 
<pgbrk id="pg1029" />must not be removed from their place; Yalk. Ex. 356 שלא יסתרו וכ' (corr. acc.).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="O01705">
<head-word>סָתַם</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.; = סחתם, 
<italic>Saf.</italic></definition>
<notes> of חתם) </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to stop up, close, shut</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ab. Zar. V, 3 כדי שישתום ויִסְתּוֹם ויגוב, v. נָגַב. B. Mets. VII, 5 שלא יהא … ויהא סוֹתֵם את הפתח וכ' that he (the laborer) must not be greedy so as to shut the door before himself (make himself objectionable to employers). Ḥull. 43
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. מרה שניקבה וכבד סוֹתַמְתָּהּ if the bladder of the gall is perforated, and the liver (adhering to the perforated spot) closes it up. Ib. 49
<sup>b</sup> חלב טהור סותם clean fat (such as it is permitted to eat) forms a stopper (to an adjacent organ, and makes the animal so affected permitted). Pes. IV, 9 (56
<sup>a</sup>) ס' מי גיחון וכ' he stopped up the water of the upper Gihon (II Chr. XXXII, 3); a. fr.—Part. pass. סָתוּם; f. סְתוּמָה; 
<plural-form>pl. סְתוּמִים, סְתוּמִין; סְתוּמוֹת</plural-form>. Yeb. 71
<sup>b</sup>; Nidd. 30
<sup>b</sup>; Lev. R. s. 14 נפתח הס' ונסתם וכ' the organ which (in the embryonic stage) was closed, opens, and that which was open, closes itself. Bets. IV, 3 בית … ס' a room filled with fruit which was closed up (with bricks). Y. ib. 62
<sup>c</sup> bot. לפסים ס' pots with their lids on (not yet cut apart); Tosef. ib. III, 13; Tosef. Sabb. XVI (XVII), 13. Snh. 94
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to לסרבה, Is. IX, 6) מפני מה כל מ"ם … וזה ס' why is every Mem in the middle of a word open, and this one is closed (final Mem). Meg. 3
<sup>a</sup> פתוחין … וס' בסוף וכ' open in the middle of words and closed at the end (v. מנצפ"ך); a. fr.—Esp. פרשה סתומה 
<italic>a paragraph in the Torah separated from the preceding by a vacant space in the middle of the line</italic>, opp. to פתוחה a section beginning a new indented line. Gen. R. s. 96, beg., v. infra. Treat. Sof’rim I, 14 איזוהי ס' כל שהניח וכ' what is a closed paragraph? When space is left &c.; וכמה יניח … ותהא נקראת ס' and how much space must be left …, in order that the paragraph may be called closed?; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to conceal</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. l. c. (ref. to the section beginning with Gen. XLVII, 28) that paragraph is closed, שס' ממנו וכ' because the Lord concealed from his vision all (coming) troubles; (Yalk. ib. 154 שנסתמו ממנו, v. infra); a. e.—
<italic>Part. pass.</italic> as ab. 
<italic>concealed, not explicitly stated</italic>, opp. מפורש. Zeb. 53
<sup>a</sup> יִלָּמֵד ס' מן המפורש let that which is not explicitly stated in a law be derived (by analogy) from what is explicitly stated; Sifra Aḥăré, beg. יְלַמֵּד פתוח על הס' let the explicit statement throw light on the implicit. Meg. 15
<sup>a</sup> כל … אבותיו ס' a person (mentioned in the Bible) whose deeds and the deeds of whose ancestors are not stated; a. fr.—Y. Bets. l. c. (in Chald. dict.) סתומה 
<italic>the anonymous opinion</italic>, v. סְתָמָא.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִסְתַּם, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִסְתַּתֵּם, </binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>Nithpa.</italic> נִסְתַּתֵּם 
<italic>to be closed; to be concealed; to be silenced</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. l. c. בקש … ונ' ממנו 
<pgbrk id="pg1032" />Jacob wanted to reveal the end of the captivity, and it was closed before him; Yalk. ib. l. c. נִסְתְּמוּ ממנו, v. supra. Cant. R. to I, 4 היה אומר … ומִסְתַּתְּמִין he said a word (of charm) over them, and they became silent (dumb). Snh. 31
<sup>b</sup> לעולם … עד שיִסְתַּתֵּם טענותיו (Alf. שיִסְתּוֹם; Asheri שיסתיר) he may continually bring evidence and refute, until he declares himself closed as to his pleas, i.e., until he declares that he has no more evidence to offer. Yeb. 76
<sup>a</sup>; Tosef. ib. X, 4, a. e. נ' כשר if the perforation in the membrum has closed itself again, he is considered unblemished. Kel. XIV, 8 נִסְתַּתְּמוּ נקבין if the holes have been stopped up. Snh. 94
<sup>a</sup> לכך נ' therefore the Mem was closed (the final מ was written). Sot. 13
<sup>b</sup> נסתתמו ממנו שערי וכ' the gates of wisdom were closed before him (he lost his judicial judgment); a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>סִיתֵּם</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to close</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Snh. X, 28
<sup>c</sup> bot. היו … מְסַתְּמִין וכ' the ministering angels closed the windows (of heaven) that the prayer of Manasseh might not rise; Deut. R. s. 2; (Pesik. Shub., p. 162
<sup>b</sup> סוֹתְמִין).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="O01706">
<head-word>סְתַם</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same.</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> Targ. II Chr. XXXII, 3. Targ. II Esth. I, 2 (3) ס' נפשיה (the gate) closed itself; a. fr.—Part. pass. סְתִים; f. סְתִימָא; 
<plural-form>pl. סְתִימִין, סְתִימַיָּא; סְתִימָן</plural-form>. Targ. Ez. XLI, 16. Targ. Y. I Gen. XLIX, 1; a. e.—Ḥull. 49
<sup>b</sup> חד סָתֵים one of them stops up a perforation (by close adhesion, v. preced.). Ib. sq. אינהו … ולדידן מִיסְתַּם נמי לא ס' they eat (that kind of fat), and for us was it not even to have the effect of closing up the perforation (that the animal in the case be permitted)?; a. fr.—Esp. 
<italic>to conceal an authority; to state a law without naming the author</italic>. Bets. 2
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Sabb. XXIV, 4) דס' לן תנא כר"ש where the editor of the Mishnah states the law anonymously, in agreement with R. S.’s opinion. Ib.
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Bets. IV, 3) דס' לן תנא כד"י where the editor gives R. Judah’s opinion anonymously; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>סַתֵּם</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> same.</definition>
<notes> Gitt. 68
<sup>a</sup> וסַתְּמִינְהוּ בגבבי וכ' and stopped the waters up with wool.—Part. pass. מְסַתַּם; f. מְסַתְּמָא; 
<plural-form>pl. מְסַתְּמִין; מְסַתְּמָן</plural-form>. Meg. 3
<sup>a</sup> in the Prophets איכא מילי … דמ' (Ms. O. דסְתִימָן) some things are clearly stated, others obscurely.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִסְתַּתַּם</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>; 
<italic>Ithpe.</italic> אִסְתְּתַם 
<italic>to be closed, stopped up, sealed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Esth. VIII, 10. Ib. V, 14 (some ed. אסתממו, incorr.); a. fr.—Targ. Y. Lev. XV, 3 אִיתְסַתַּם (v. חֲתַם).—Keth. 106
<sup>a</sup> איסתתם טענתיה (v. preced.) he declared he had nothing to say (was intimidated). Shebu. 30
<sup>b</sup> מִסְתַּתְּמָן טענתיה דבעל וכ' (Ms. M. קמִסְתַּתְּמָא) the opponent will be intimidated; Yalk. Deut. 922 מִיסַּתְּמָא טענתיה וכ'; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="O01707">
<head-word>סְתָם</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>closing up</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Ab. Zar. VII (VIII), 14; Ab. Zar. 69
<sup>b</sup>, v. סְתוֹם, a. שְׁתָם.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>something unknown, undefined</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. 74
<sup>a</sup> bot. סְתַם יינן Ms. M. a. Rashi (ed. יין) wine of gentiles of which it is not known that it has been dedicated to an idol, opp. יין נסך; Ḥull. 4
<sup>b</sup>. Y. Ab. Zar. III, 43
<sup>b</sup> bot. בס' חלוקין they differ with regard to a tree (Asherah) of which it is not known that is has been worshipped. Ib. סְתָמָן עובדין וכ' those of them (the gentiles) not otherwise known worship an image but not a tree. Macc. 3
<sup>b</sup> המלוה את חבירו ס' he who makes a loan to his neighbor without terms, cannot claim payment before thirty days. Snh. 25
<sup>b</sup> ס' גבאי כשר a tax collector, unless known to be dishonest, is admissible as witness; ס' רועה פסול a shepherd, unless known to guard his flock from illicit pasture, is disqualified. B. Mets. 69
<sup>a</sup> (in Chald. dict.) ס' אריסא וכ' the presumption is that a tenant obligates himself, etc. R. Hash. 7
<sup>b</sup> ס' כי אגר וכ' as a rule, when one rents a house etc.; a. v. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>an opinion stated without an authority, anonymous opinion</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yeb. 42
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. מחלוקת ואח"כ ס' הלכה כס' where differing opinions are quoted and followed by an anonymous opinion (‘the scholars say’), the latter is the practice. Ḥull. 43
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. הלכה כס' משנה the practice follows the anonymous opinion in the Mishnah. Snh. 86
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. ס' מתני' ר' מאיר וכ' wherever an anonymous opinion is stated in the Mishnah, it is R. Meïr’s; in the Tosefta, etc.; a. fr.—Y. Sot. I, 17
<sup>b</sup> bot. כתוב לה ס' write the order for two men without specified names.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
